init.title: Venice AI
init.description: Settings shared by all services of this entry. Each service has its own settings under Reconfigure.

data_description.private_models_only: Offer only models that Venice AI runs privately or in a TEE, so prompts and audio are not passed to providers that may keep them. A repair issue reports services that use other models.
data_description.image_model: Model used by the generate_image action when no model is given.
data_description.request_timeout: How long to wait for a Venice AI response before giving up.

abort.entry_not_loaded: Cannot change services while the Venice AI entry is not loaded.

data_description.prompt: Instructions sent to the model with every conversation. Supports templates.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Home Assistant APIs the model may use to read and control your devices.
data_description.chat_model: Venice AI text model. TEE models run in an attested hardware enclave; models tagged with tools can control Home Assistant.
data_description.recommended: Use the recommended sampling and reasoning settings. Turn off to adjust them on the next step.

data_description.max_tokens: Maximum number of tokens the model may generate in a single answer.
data_description.temperature: Higher values make answers more creative, lower values more focused.
data_description.top_p: Limits sampling to the most likely tokens whose probabilities add up to this value.
data_description.disable_thinking: Ask reasoning models to skip the thinking phase for faster, cheaper answers.
data_description.thinking_tags: Names of the tags that wrap reasoning in the answers of the model, separated by commas, for example think or think, thought.
data_description.include_venice_system_prompt: Let Venice AI add its own system prompt to every request, next to yours.
data_description.strip_thinking_response: Keep the reasoning wrapped in the thinking tags out of the answer.
data_description.stream_response: Receive the answer incrementally, which lowers the time to the first words.
data_description.max_tool_iterations: How many rounds of Home Assistant tool calls the model may make per request.
data_description.max_history_messages: How many earlier messages of the conversation are sent with each request. The current question is always sent.
